Hi Sonia — Lauren here (Solutions Engineering). Quick answers inline to your questions and a little more color on what we can bring to the security call.

- VPC/private deployment: yes — we offer a Private deployment option (VPC + private control plane) that many fintech customers use. It supports a customer-managed VPC peering or private link and can be deployed into your cloud project.
- BYOK / KMS: we support HSM-backed customer keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and can provide a hardware-backed option for higher-security tiers.
- Audit logs: our Private deployment includes detailed per-request audit logs with identity traces (token id, request id, model version, timestamps). Hosted API also provides trace-level logs but may be subject to aggregation for multi-tenant customers — for full isolated tracing you'd use Private.
- SOC2 / pen-test: we will share SOC2 Type II report under NDA and a redacted pen-test summary.

I've uploaded a short one-page architecture note we typically review during intake; it clarifies which components are 'in scope' versus out-of-scope for hosted customers. For the intake call, we recommend both an infra/security engineer and whoever owns procurement attend.
